LESSON: WRITING WRITING SKILLS

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.2: Writing WRITING skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Writing WRITING skills
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: where they turn pages from right to left as books when writing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. practise Writing WRITING skills
2. use Writing WRITING skills in clear sentences

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Writing WRITING skills

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Writing WRITING skills

Teach
• Focus skill: Writing WRITING skills.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Writing WRITING skills.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Writing WRITING skills
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. where they turn pages from right to left as books when writing?
2. Where do we place our (2HRS) a) Hold a writing tool • Learners could be guided to write patterns hands when writing?
3. How do we position our class. • Learners could be guided in activities on hands while writing?
4. How do we hold the writing to left during a writing between the index finger and the thumb, tool when writing?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
